meta.purpose: Fire when the Structural Analysis Agent finishes a processing cycle for a bridge, then invoke the Risk Reasoning Agent service entrypoint (R1002) with that {bridge_id, cycle_id}. One assessment per bridge per SA cycle (FR-3a). GLUE ONLY — contains NO scoring/reasoning/judgment logic (Constitution III: modularity; n8n moves data, the Python service decides). [n8n/Supabase live verification deferred — none locally.]
meta.invokes: src/agents/risk_reasoning/service.py :: run_assessment (exposed over HTTP by the Risk deployment) — one call per bridge, per SA cycle
meta.scoring_logic: none — every part of the risk judgment lives in the Python service (R1002), never here; n8n only forwards the scope and routes on the structured ok flag
meta.upstream: Structural Analysis Agent cycle-complete signal (SA posts {bridge_id, cycle_id} to this webhook when its analysis_results for the cycle are persisted)

nodes.name: SA Cycle Complete
nodes.notes: Fires when the Structural Analysis Agent finishes a cycle for one bridge and posts {bridge_id, cycle_id, bridge_type}. No inspection of analysis contents here — the scope is forwarded as-is.

nodes.name: Invoke Risk Reasoning Agent (R1002)
nodes.notes: POST the {bridge_id, cycle_id, bridge_type} scope to the Python service entrypoint. Retries the TRIGGER/invoke up to 3x on transport failure (Constitution IV: reliability). Redelivery is safe — the service is idempotent per scope (FR-3a: supersede, not duplicate). The service returns a structured AssessmentSummary; n8n does not interpret the verdict it carries.

nodes.name: Assessment Accepted?
nodes.notes: Branch on the service's structured ok flag only — NEVER on the verdict the service returns. Any routing on the verdict itself (e.g. handing a to-be-reviewed verdict to the Alert Agent) is downstream and out of scope for this glue workflow.

parameters.content: Assessment invocation failed at the service boundary (ok=false). Log + alert ops. The error detail is in {{ $json.error }}. No retry here — the HTTP node already retried transport; an ok=false is a structured result, not a transport fault.
Assessment accepted and persisted by the service (risk_assessments + decision_log + trace). Nothing further for n8n to do here; downstream routing is a separate workflow.
